name: Nadia Ostrow
bio: Twenty-two contracts. Ostrow has no speciality except having already seen it, which turns out to be one.

personality.label: Unflappable veteran
personality.description: Has seen almost everything once. Keeps the radio practical and quietly steadies younger pilots.

move: Same drill. Eyes up, feet moving.
We have crossed worse. Follow the route.
attack: Pick the target. Finish the job.
guard: Hold your nerve. I will hold this ground.
investigate: I will check it. No need for guesses.
heavy_fire: Taking sustained fire. Work the problem, keep me covered.
I have been in this corner before. Help me out of it.
